al-Suyuti_al-Itqan.note: al-Suyūṭī's chronological list places Q 64 as the 108th-revealed surah, well into the Medinan period

Tanzil_Egyptian_Standard.note: 1924 Cairo printed muṣḥaf classifies Q 64 as Medinan; aligns with Suyūṭī tradition

Noldeke_Geschichte_des_Qorans.note: Nöldeke ranks Q 64 as the 93rd surah revealed; firmly Medinan in his stratification

Ata_ibn_Yasar_via_Ibn_Ishaq_via_al-Tabar.specifics: Entire Q 64 is Meccan EXCEPT vv. 14-16 (the wives-and-children-as-trial passage), which are Medinan
Ata_ibn_Yasar_via_Ibn_Ishaq_via_al-Tabar.isnad: Ibn Ḥumayd → Salama → Muḥammad b. Isḥāq → an associate → ʿAṭāʾ ibn Yasār
Ata_ibn_Yasar_via_Ibn_Ishaq_via_al-Tabar.note: Pre-tafsīr-consolidation early classical position; the dissent is documented in al-Ṭabarī's compendium and reproduced verbatim by al-Baghawī

al-Baghawi_Maalim_al-Tanzil.specifics: Header reads 'مدنية - قال عطاء هي مكية إلا ثلاث آيات' (Medinan; ʿAṭāʾ said it is Meccan except for three verses)
al-Baghawi_Maalim_al-Tanzil.note: Preserves the dissent in the surah-header, indicating the classical tradition treated this as a contested case

Ibn_Abbas_via_al-Wahidi_asbab.specifics: Asbāb al-nuzūl for v.14 anchors the wives-and-children passage to Meccan converts who were prevented from the Hijra by their families — i.e. the Late-Meccan / Hijra-transition moment
Ibn_Abbas_via_al-Wahidi_asbab.note: The asbāb places v.14 at the Hijra-transition itself, making the verses chronologically Meccan-Medinan-hinge regardless of the surah's overall classification

verdict_summary: Q 64 is a contested chronology case. Modern editions (Tanzil, Nöldeke) and majority classical position (al-Suyūṭī) classify Medinan (rev #108 / Nöldeke #93). An EARLY CLASSICAL DISSENT preserved by al-Ṭabarī (via Ibn Isḥāq → ʿAṭāʾ ibn Yasār) and acknowledged by al-Baghawī assigns the surah to MECCA except for vv. 14-16 (the wives-and-children-as-trial passage), which are anchored to the Late-Meccan / Hijra-transition via the asbāb on Meccan converts blocked by their families from migrating. The Q064-F-04 audit thus CONFIRMS a documented classical chronology disagreement.
